Classification: review-confirmed defect.

3. **P2 — Approval callbacks can delay execution past expiry.**  
   [runtime.ex:109](/Users/mhostetler/Source/Jido/proj_jido_integration/jido_connect/apps/jido_connect/lib/jido_connect/runtime/runtime.ex:109) checks snapshot expiry before policy and approval callbacks. At [runtime.ex:126](/Users/mhostetler/Source/Jido/proj_jido_integration/jido_connect/apps/jido_connect/lib/jido_connect/runtime/runtime.ex:126), execution follows approval validation without another expiry check.  
   **Evidence:** A 300 ms validator delay let the handler run after both the snapshot and its 200 ms lease had expired.  
   **Correction:** Check snapshot and lease expiry again after callbacks, immediately before the handler call. Apply the lease check to invoke and poll paths too.

Acceptance: Reproduce the reported case against current source, apply the smallest correction described above, and add focused verification of both the failing case and supported behavior. For documentation/design work, update the public contract and verify its examples/callers. Preserve tenant, scope, lease, and host ownership boundaries. Use fresh matching v3 dependencies for final verification; saved local v2 build artifacts do not establish v3 conformance.

Do not modify jido_mcp or publish packages. Full source review and its coverage/verification limits are preserved in the parent epic comments.

comments.text: Fixed in 269cef97. Expiry is checked again after callbacks; focused runtime and Things tests pass. Full umbrella mix quality and demo format, warnings-as-errors compile, and 21 demo tests pass.
